Subject: Special Announcement: happysheep is alive!

Special Announcement: happysheep is alive!

Hi Tony,

Simon Barton (GP Store's big boss) has been working hard with the team
from Zillion on a brand new free local classified site that we think
you'll love!

Think of it like an online version of the community notice board you
find outside your local dairy...

Visit happysheep at:

http://www.happysheep.co.nz/

The team aims to make happysheep the #1 place in New Zealand for local
events,community notices, classes and activities, jobs, services,
stuff for sale and more!

Best of all, it's 100% free. Plus, place a listing in March and you
couldwin an Apple iPhone!

Please help happysheep to get off to a great start by visiting
happysheep today and placing a free listing. If you think the site is
great then please tell your friends and help spread the word!

Regards,

All the team at Gameplanet Store New Zealand.
http://www.gpstore.co.nz/
